MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN MEDALLION (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON THIS_______________________________ 
 
 Agenda 
 
 Change in principal line of business 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to alter the provisions of the Memorandum of Association (“ Memorandum ”) of the Company, subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company and in pursuance of the relevant provisions of the Companies Act, 2017, and other applicable laws. 
 
 Holding extra-ordinary general meeting 
 
 The Board was also informed that in order to effect the alteration of the provisions of the Memorandum of the Company, an extra-ordinary general meeting (“ EOGM ”) of the shareholders convened on [●] to present the present for alteration of the provisions of the Memorandum of the Company before the shareholders for their approval. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in details the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board : 
 
 Resolved that , the Company be and is hereby authorized to alter the provisions of the Memorandum of the Company to change the principal line of business of the Company , subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Company and in pursuance of the relevant provisions of the Companies Act, 2017, and other applicable laws. 
 
 Resolved further that , the Company be and is hereby authorized to convene an EOGM of the shareholders of the Company on [●] so as to put the proposal for alteration of the provisions of the Memorandum of the Company before the shareholders of the Company for their approval.
